Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q1 2020 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of UNH.
We generated $19.5 billion in free cash flow, enabling us to return capital to shareholders.
Revenue guidance of $11.7 billion assumes no further deterioration in consumer spending trends.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q1 2020.
Our cloud segment grew 19% year-over-year, driven by strong enterprise demand.
We anticipate margins may be impacted by approximately 53 basis points pending supplier contract renewals.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
How are you thinking about pricing power versus volume growth in the current environment?
Thank you for the question. We delivered record revenue of $11.7 billion this quarter, representing 19% year-over-year growth.
Second question - Analyst:
What assumptions underpin your free cash flow guidance given the elevated capex spend?
We believe the pipeline is strong, but conversion timing remains uncertain given customer budget cycles.
